text:
marta: Quick profiling heads-up — canary on g5x shows an unexpected p95 tail increase (~40ms). Raw numbers: prefill ~60% of total latency, decode ~30%, other overhead ~10%. Kernel selector might be flipping to slower path.

marta: Perf snippet:
```
[perf] prefill: 120ms
[perf] decode: 70ms
p95: 210ms -> 250ms
kv_cache_hit: 0.82 -> 0.78
```

devon: I think this lines up with the kernel selector tweak from last week. We had a defensive fallback to `generic_gemm` for certain seq lengths after a crash in the fused path.

kai: We should log the chosen kernel per request. Right now we only emit aggregate counts. I'll add opt-in `kernel_debug=true` flag to the runtime.

priyanka: Also check microbatching: our canary pool uses microbatch=8. That could be increasing prefill wait time and bumping tail. Suggest trying microbatch=4.

marta: KV cache miss rate also ticked up (~4% delta). Could be shard rebalance/evictions during the rollout — I saw `kv_lookup_miss` spikes in the same window.

devon: Repro steps I'm using locally:
```
./perf_harness --device g5x --seq_len 256 --batch_size 4 --microbatch 4 --trace kernel_selector
```
Kernel selector pseudo:
```
if seq_len <= 64:
  use fwd_fused_attn
elif seq_len <= 256 and device in ['g5x']:
  use triton_block_attn_v2
else:
  use generic_gemm
```

kai: Action items: (1) add per-request kernel log + metric `kernel_fallback_reason`, (2) expose microbatch aggregation timeout as runtime config for low-latency tiers.

priyanka: On it — starting an A/B: microbatch=4 + KV_TTL=120s on canary, will report in ~2h.

perf-bot: Benchmark job #789 queued: test/g5x/seq256/micro4

marta: Longer-term idea: decouple prefill vs decode scheduling. Prefill can use larger batching but decode needs priority lanes to reduce tail. Also revisit KV eviction policy (LRU vs segmented) for long-running sessions.

devon: Quick patch proposal: lower microbatch aggregation timeout from 15ms -> 8ms for `latency_slo` pools. I'll draft a PR but want throughput sweep before roll.

kai: I'll run throughput sweep across timeouts [8,12,15] with microbatch=4 and seq lens [64,256].

priyanka: Early results: microbatch=4 + timeout=8ms reduced p99 by ~18% on canary, throughput -6%. KV miss didn't change until TTL bumped to 120s.

marta: Good signal. Plan: roll microbatch=4 + timeout=8ms to canary, revert kernel-selector change until we have the logs. Devon please open a regression hunt issue with traces and perf job links.

devon: Done — issue #2331 created and assigned to infra-runtime. Perf link: http://ci/perf/789

priyanka: :thumbsup: Following up on KV cache eviction root cause and will post findings.
